Build a pricing page with three plans (Solo, Team, Business), a monthly/yearly toggle, a feature comparison and an FAQ.

Write it as a single React component file in TypeScript using Tailwind CSS classes, with a default export. Use realistic sample data inline. Output only the code, in one ```tsx block.

const features = [ { feature: "Unlimited projects", solo: true, team: true, business: true }, { feature: "Team members", solo: "1", team: "5", business: "Unlimited" }, { feature: "Storage", solo: "10 GB", team: "100 GB", business: "1 TB" }, { feature: "Basic analytics", solo: true, team: true, business: true }, { feature: "Advanced analytics", solo: false, team: true, business: true }, { feature: "Custom reporting", solo: false, team: false, business: true }, { feature: "Email support", solo: true, team: true, business: true }, { feature: "Priority support", solo: false, team: true, business: true }, { feature: "Dedicated support", solo: false, team: false, business: true }, { feature: "SLA guarantee", solo: false, team: false, business: true }, { feature: "API access", solo: true, team: true, business: true }, { feature: "SSO authentication", solo: false, team: true, business: true }, { feature: "Audit logs", solo: false, team: false, business: true }, { feature: "Custom domains", solo: false, team: true, business: true }, { feature: "On-premise option", solo: false, team: false, business: true }, ];
